title: Paper card
description: One paper = one card. The single source of truth for facts taken from a paper. Every claim/result must carry a location and a short verbatim quote so it can be checked against the PDF.

id.description: Card ID. Must equal the file name (papers/<id>.yaml). arXiv: 'arxiv-2401.01234' (version suffix not included; the version goes in source.version). DOI only: 'doi-' + DOI with '/' replaced by '_'.

venue.description: e.g. 'NeurIPS 2022 (Datasets and Benchmarks)'. Omit if preprint only.

source.description: Exactly which document the card was written from. Quotes are only guaranteed to match this version.

pdf_sha256.description: SHA-256 of cache/pdfs/<id>.pdf (the PDF itself is never committed).

license.description: Paper license if stated (e.g. 'CC BY 4.0', 'arXiv non-exclusive'). Omit if unknown.

tags.description: All values must exist in registry/tags.yaml.

proposes.description: Method(s) newly proposed in this paper. Empty for surveys/benchmark papers.

claims.description: Qualitative claims, summarised in our own words, each backed by a quote.

results.description: Numeric results. Only these numbers may appear in generated comparison tables.

method.description: Method name exactly as used in the paper's table.

metric.description: Must be one of the benchmark's metrics.

std.description: Reported spread, if any (state which kind in 'note').

quote.description: For tables: the row text or cell as it appears, e.g. 'XGBoost 0.873'.

relations.description: Within-paper win/loss relations (Q12) that cannot be derived from 'results' (e.g. average rank over a suite). Relations between results on the same benchmark are derived automatically and must NOT be repeated here.

basis.description: What the comparison is on, e.g. 'average rank over 45 datasets, default hyperparameters'.

benchmark.description: Registry ID, if the relation is on a registered condition.

created_by.description: e.g. 'claude-opus-5-5 via Claude Code' or a person's name.

reviewed.description: true only after a human checked the claims/results against the PDF.

location.description: Where in the paper, e.g. 'Table 2', 'Section 4.1', 'Figure 3 caption', 'Appendix B.2'.

quote.description: Short verbatim excerpt (one sentence at most) from the PDF in source.pdf_sha256. Kept short to stay within quotation.
